profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at DELL/EMC
profile.summary:
o Experience in complex builds & sanity tests with quick turn around
o Experience in build & tools automation
o Timely resolution of issues for release 
o Rank 100% on delivery on time
o Frequently ranked high on teamwork and  cooperative spirit
o An eye for continuous build process improvement

Specialties: o OS:  Unix , Linux, Windows,  Sun NFS
o Languages: Shell Programming, Perl, HTML, Javascript, MySQL, batch files, 1750A assembly
o Configuration Management Software:  Perforce, SVN, Git, RCS, SCCS, PVCS, Teamware
o Perforce and Git Administration on user accounts, new depot, access write and branch management.
o AWS Administration on EC2: create/terminate and monitor EC2 instances, 
o Unix System Administration on Solaris/Linux  build servers/systems
o Project Management with Leankit Kanban (Agile)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supports EMC DPSG engineering by automating builds, maintaining building tools (Perl, Shell scripts, batch, Electric Cloud, Jenkins, Docker containers, etc.) and systems used in software development. Ensures that new software is released in a streamlined manner from development to production. Establishes procedures and develops tools that are used by our R&D teams. Drive product releases across many different systems and teams. Confluence administration.

Responsibilities:
    Own, manage, and improve our build processes, build systems, and continuous integration to support ongoing R&D (Perforce and Git).
    Support and develop tools for continuous integration and release management.
    Design, implement and manage build system for new projects
    Handle source drop, patches, hotfixes releases
    Handle source tree branching for releases and builds
    Create and monitor Jenkins CI builds/pineline and unit tests daily including trouble shooting.
    Handle filtering official build compilation messages/warnings using Perl.
    Trouble shooting official build problems and build servers.
    Handle new Confluence space creation and user accounts
    Create and monitor Jenkins CI builds and utests daily including trouble shooting.
    Create docker container for builds used by DEV

positions.title: Sr.  Release Engineer
positions.description:
•	Maintain source control branches and control engineering team’s access to those branches depending on the release schedules.
•	Maintain Continuous Integration Server (Jenkins) to meet the requirements of engineering team.
•	Maintain and upgrade SCM tools such as SVN, Jenkins, Maven, Ant, Online CRF application, Artifactory, Bugzilla, Testopia, Nagios, Weblogic, various build servers, and package repository, as well as improving custom integration modules that integrate with the mentioned SCM tools. 
•	Maintain, refresh, or upgrade AWS Development and QA servers stacks and sync the infrastructure when necessary.
•	Consolidate release change requests from various teams and build and deploy on integration QA server stacks.  This is a daily task.
•	Consolidate production patch change requests, build and deploy on production level QA stack, and review/correct/improve change instructions to comply with standards and release quality builds.
•	Work on key Release Engineering deliverables, such as Auto Deployment Framework, Auto Stack Refresh Framework, Database MySql/SQL Configuration Management and SCM tool disaster recovery set up and documentation.
•	AWS/Web based environment and automating deployments and infrastructure
•	Subversion Source Control System Administration .
•	Linux, Solaris, and Windows operating system deployments and administration

positions.title: Sr. Build and Release Engineer (contract)
positions.description:
•	Coordinated with engineering/Project managers and ensure software/patches were released 
timely to QAers and deploy releases through the web and  Yum repo areas.
•	Create/configure/setup CI Jenkins/Hudson tool for build automation setup (Shell/batch/Perl scripting) which supports Linux, Fedora  and windows builds. 
•	Monitor all CI builds for development  and SCM team for multiple projects ( make, Maven,  Gcc, Gcc++) on Jenkins daily.
•	Migrate builds from different OS versions into one OS versions for Windows (.Net) & Linux  (CentOS)  which involves build environment setup and Jenkins.
•	Perforce source tree branching management and administration
•	Manage/ setup/maintain CentOS  6.x servers/platforms in the lab. Yum packages installation and update.  Setup/test Repo areas and repo scripts.
•	Document all tools and builds instructions/setup procedures.

positions.title: Sr Release Engineer and QA
positions.description:
•	Design, implement, and administrate Build Request page in Footprint database
•	Coordinate with engineering/QA/Project managers and ensure software is released in a streamlined manner from development to production. Develop Windows & Linux build automation tools (bash) for multi-projects including FTP/DCC release process.
•	Manage/automate domestic and oversea Software source code releases and versioning (Japan, Korea, and China) in the fast moving multi-functional teams.
•	Implement auto make menu for different software build selections.
•	Configurate QuickBuild server which links with Perforce server for compilation test builds (Perl).
•	Perforce source tree branching management for releases and administration
•	Support nightly/daily/weekly auto builds for multi-projects.
•	Support Acceptance, HDMI, Video tests and bug verification on internal/External releases/builds on Zoran TVs with QA reports. 
•	Support other testing on TVs for shipments.

positions.title: Software Release Engineer
positions.description:
 Maintained build scripts, tools and improved build automation.
 Built Solaris Graphics Software for OS by integrating 5 complex systems, and analyzed build problem/code changes (SCCS, Teamware) including sanity tests.
 Automated builds for new application software (domestic/L10N for CD release), including package auditing, sanity tests and creation of CD installation scripts.
 Managed patch builds (Solaris 5.1- Solaris 9, and X86) to address customer escalations and bugfixes (bi-weekly and on demands).
 Consistently given access to change source code/Makefiles for global functions and complier changes.
 Administered source gates/servers and build systems. 
 Tracked release metrics to construct annual build schedules.
 Created/Updated webpage for build docs and bug reports in Bugtraq II for all releases.

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description:
Release Engineer, CELLNET DATA SYSTEMS, San Carlos, CA 	1996-1997
•	Built large kernel system software (required 32 hours compilation time) and firmware for releases on Sun Sparc (daily/nightly builds).
•	Enhanced and maintained the RCS/PVCS -based SCM (Software Configuration Management) wrapper that facilitates the development processes, such as check in/out, revision control of branches, merges, labeling and distribution.
